title: 497E — Forest Moon Galaxy Explorer
description: A 1978-style Galaxy Explorer built by Ewok engineers. Blue spars frame plaited leaf wings; bark rockets, an orange-hooded yellow cockpit, ear scanners and branching landing struts blend woodland craft with Classic Space. An open cargo basket, boarding ramp, woodland moon buggy and living radar beacon serve four space-suited Ewoks.

sections.name: Five log landing struts and connected keel
Hooded command capsule and ear scanners
Bark rockets and leaf tail fins
